What it does

Workiz is notable for treating the phone as part of the job system rather than something separate. Calls, texts and job records sit together, so a missed call is visible as a missed opportunity instead of disappearing. It is cheaper and easier to start than the enterprise platforms, at the cost of depth on complex job costing.

Where the AI actually is

AI assistance for call handling, scheduling and follow-ups.

Pros

  • Built-in phone system with call tracking
  • Cheaper entry point than the enterprise platforms
  • Easy to get started

Cons

  • Less depth on complex job costing

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Landscapers in mind. Small teams that live on the phone and want calls tied to jobs.

Alternatives
